Leo M: Quick sync — CloudNode wants sa-east-1 (South America) enabled. Asks: marketplace entitlement, 10x A100-80GB reserve, HSM/KMS pattern, and a soft embargo for joint announce. Who can take the entitlement?
Priya (CloudNode): We can reserve 10 A100-80 (cn-a100-80-prod) and allow cn-a10-40 as burst. KMS: require HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM ok). Rotation 90 days. Target go-live 2026-10-05.
Kiera G: I'll draft the entitlement and submit. Need exact SKU ids (Priya provided) and go-live confirmed. Also legal addendum required for in-region logs.
Tom H: Ops checklist: canary window proposal 2026-09-28 08:00-11:00 UTC; success criteria: p95 < 260ms, sustained 500k tokens/hr, fallback to a10 < 30%. I'll schedule once entitlement is submitted.
LegalBot: addendum-template uploaded to drive for review.
Priya (CloudNode): Confirmed. We'll run partner-side canary 2026-09-27. We can add +5 GPUs within 7 business days if needed.
Kiera G: Draft payload:
```json
{
  "partner":"CloudNode",
  "region":"sa-east-1",
  "skus":["cn-a100-80-prod","cn-a10-40-burst"],
  "reserved_capacity":10,
  "go_live_date":"2026-10-05"
}
```
OpsBot: marketplace-submission: submission_id=msub-20260815-621; status=review_pending
Leo M: Good cadence. Plan: entitlement submit this week, legal signed by 2026-09-15, canaries late Sept, announce 2026-10-19 (two-week embargo). Assignments: Kiera entitlement, Tom ops, LegalBot follow-up, Priya partner coordination.
Priya (CloudNode): Will send marketing blurb by Tue. Excited to get SA online! :globe_with_meridians:
